newsitem.title: USA: Henkel says Loctite offering information.
newsitem.headline: Henkel says Loctite offering information.

text.p: Henkel KGaA said Loctite Corp, which it is trying to buy, had agreed to provide Henkel and its HC Investments subsidiary with access to key information , including projections, about Loctite.

In early November, Henkel launched a $57.75 per share bid for the 65 percent of Loctite it did not already own. On November 18, Loctite rejected the bid as financially inadequate, but Henkel said it remained "highly interested" in entering into a negotiated transaction.
Henkel said Loctite had agreed to provide information prepared for potential Loctite acquirors.
Henkel, a German chemicals and consumer products group best known for its Persil washing powder, said the tender offer, made by its HC Investments unit, was scheduled to expire on January 6.
Loctite is a U.S.-based adhesives maker.
